from pathlib import Path
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
day='2026-11-02'
inbox=Path.home()/'Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/youchu_ai_inbox.jsonl'
# also outbox/sent
for label,p in [
 ('inbox', inbox),
 ('sent', Path.home()/'Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/sent.jsonl'),
 ('outbox', Path.home()/'Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/outbox.jsonl'),
]:
  if not p.exists():
    print(label,'MISSING'); continue
  n=0
  print('\n==',label,'==')
  for line in p.open():
    line=line.strip()
    if not line: continue
    try:o=json.loads(line)
    except:continue
    # try various time fields
    blob=json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False)
    if day not in blob: continue
    ts=o.get('created_at') or o.get('ts') or o.get('time') or o.get('sent_at') or ''
    bid=o.get('bus_id') or o.get('id') or (o.get('message') or {}).get('bus_id')
    text=(o.get('text') or o.get('body') or (o.get('message') or {}).get('text') or '')
    if isinstance(text,dict): text=str(text)
    text=str(text).replace('\n',' ')[:200]
    # filter to today more strictly
    if day not in str(ts) and day not in blob[:300]:
      continue
    if day in str(ts) or (isinstance(o.get('created_at'),str) and o['created_at'].startswith(day)):
      n+=1
      if n<=30:
        print(n, str(ts)[:19], bid, text)
  print('count',n)
